verdict.rationale: Keycloak has no named sandbox feature, but its docs give the pieces to build one. You can start a throwaway local dev instance with a single `docker run ... start-dev` command, use realms as isolated tenants, and import or export realms as JSON to seed test environments. A community user notes that configuration lives in the database and that there is 'no easy supported way to test some changes before production', so promoting tested changes takes real extra work. Missing for 10: a first-party sandbox or test-mode environment, a documented dev-to-prod promotion workflow, test or synthetic data tooling, and independent hands-on corroboration of sandbox use.
